card.name: Linking words in immune-related label text
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or section numbers in drug-label text about immune suppression, autoimmunity, infection or blood counts, such as 'with' after 'concurrently' or 'in' after 'an increase'.

modes.description: Short words like with, for, in, of that come right before terms such as immunosuppressive therapy, infections or autoantibodies.
